comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Online adult university degrees for military and veterans; UTI is hands-on trade training at its own campuses.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Outsources enrollment and marketing services to one university; it does not deliver training or sell to students.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Campus-based career colleges charging students tuition for hands-on healthcare training, matching UTI's Concorde healthcare model.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Online degree and certificate programs for working adults through universities; different delivery and student profile from UTI's hands-on trades training.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Degree-granting universities for adults, largely online, with Australasian operations; not hands-on technical trades training.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Virtual K-12 public schools sold to districts and families; a different business from postsecondary technical training.
